art_direction: 一轮银灰月球占据中心，斜侧光照出少量大陨坑，黑蓝背景。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Render a full silver-gray moon with light falling from the upper right, showing a restrained cluster of large craters and broad dark plains. Keep the lunar disc centered and isolated on nearly black blue space. The texture should be tactile but simplified enough to remain clear as an avatar, with no exaggerated cracks or mountains. Add a very faint rim at the shadowed side and only two or three distant stars. Avoid Earth, eclipsing bodies, spacecraft, and photographic interface markings. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
